title: Content Specialist
description:
Our purpose


ecoPortal health and safety engagement software helps organisations amplify workplace safety. We give leaders the data they need to create awe-inspiring safety cultures that ignite their team’s potential.


Engaged teams are the beating heart of industry-leading, odds-defying workplaces, and we’re committed to helping clients achieve that.


Our mission is simple: create engaged cultures and healthier environments for all.

Who we are


We’re a real tech success story, built from the ground up with a vision of transforming the health and safety industry as we know it.


Through our years, we’re anchored by our commitment to championing people. That commitment begins from the ground up... with our own team.


Our team culture is an organic creation built by our people, for our people. Differences are celebrated here, and we firmly believe that our diverse lived experiences work together to make us stronger as a whole.



The Opportunity


The Content Specialist is an exciting role in ecoPortal’s marketing team, directly contributing to our content strategy. You’ll be part of a team with big aspirations, changing perceptions of health and safety worldwide.



Ideal for someone who has:


  • A Bachelors (or higher) Degree in marketing/ journalism/ communications or similar major.
  • Exceptional written and verbal English fluency.
  • A strong understanding of SEO and CRO copywriting.
  • A flair for story-telling, with the ability to demonstrate technical writing.
  • A passion for writing with an excellent eye for detail, grammar, brand tone and style.
  • Experience in marketing in a tech and/or SaaS company is an advantage.
  • An understanding of the buyer journey and how best to capture people's interest at each stage.
  • Experience in managing Podcasts, Webinars and live content events.
  • The ability to meet deadlines, be a self-starter and have a can-do attitude.
  • Great communication skills, with the ability to liaise with both internal and external stakeholders regularly.


Key Responsibilities


  • Execution of the company’s content strategy, with the aim of educating, engaging, entertaining and empowering people across the company’s full customer lifecycle.
  • Be a driving force behind the execution of a broad range of top-notch content including ad campaigns, web copy, email marketing, blogs, case studies, webinars, event collateral, videos and more.
  • Planning webinar and podcast series and managing all production aspects, from prospecting and inviting potential speakers to writing briefings and scripts and supporting the recording or live delivery.
  • Creation of compelling monthly and quarterly newsletters, with ongoing performance tracking and a focus on finding new ways to improve engagement.
  • Keep your finger on the pulse of what’s front of mind for professionals in the world of health and safety and use that to input on content and campaign idea generation.
  • Support the Sales and Success teams by creating targeted collateral, emails, social posts and case studies to drive conversions and upsell opportunities;
  • Support the company’s SEO initiatives, scope and create content that helps the company get found via organic traffic;
  • Contribute to ecoPortal’s content strategy and execution.
  • Take a campaign approach to content development. Implement SEO best practices, test, and iterate your content and creative processes with the aim of increasing ecoPortal’s reach, generating demand, and converting prospects to customers.
  • Support other team-wide initiatives with targeted collateral (i.e. web, email) that leverages strong storytelling to get key ecoPortal messages across in inspiring and unique ways;
  • Keep your work in Trello and the content calendar up-to-date and set up other administrative processes as required;
  • Closely monitor new content trends, and proactively seek creative opportunities where these can be best utilised at the company.
  • Own and manage our content partnership relationships, agreements and event partner content.
  • Collaborate with other Creative Team members, including Graphic Designers, Video Specialists, as well as members of the Digital Marketing Team.
  • Contribute to brand and content reporting as required.
  • Support the Content Marketing Manager and wider marketing team in other areas of the business that align with your skillset as required.



Perks & Benefits:


We hope that you're excited by the possibilities that come with working at ecoPortal! In addition to our welcoming and diverse culture, we also offer these fun perks and benefits.


37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team.


⛺️ Generous Annual Leave


Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with ecoPortal.


End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at ecoPortal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you’ve been with eP, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you’re here. ✈️ ️


Professional Development: ecoPortal offer financial assistance for Business English Language Courses, apps, or training.


❤️

title: Senior SAP ABAP Developer
description:
Senior SAP ABAP Developer

Client Location: USA (Remote)

Duration: 12+ Month Contract


GlobalSource IT is working with a direct client that is seeking a Senior SAP ABAP Developer to join their team. This role is open due to the recent retirement of a long-tenured ABAP developer, and the client is looking to bring on an experienced contractor to help support and enhance their SAP environment.


This is a fully remote, long-term contract (12+ months) supporting a highly customized SAP ECC 6.0 landscape. The successful candidate must be comfortable remaining in ECC for the foreseeable future, as the client is not yet moving to S/4HANA.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and support ABAP solutions within a highly customized ECC 6.0 environment
  • Provide procurement-related ABAP development and enhancements
  • Support system integrations, including inbound and outbound interfaces
  • Perform bug fixes, minor enhancements, table updates, and occasional production support
  • Collaborate with functional teams and external vendors during upcoming integration efforts
  • Adapt to changing priorities and take ownership of assigned work with minimal oversight


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Strong, well-rounded SAP ABAP development experience in ECC 6.0
  • Procurement-related development experience (MM/P2P focus)
  • Integration experience (Coupa integration strongly preferred)
  • Solid experience with IDOCs and EDI
  • Working knowledge of SmartForms and SAPScript
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, highly customized environment
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work CST business hours


Upcoming Projects:

  • Major global Coupa implementation planned later this year
  • Coupa will replace Ariba globally, beginning in North America
  • Prior to Coupa ramp-up, work will focus on:
  • Minor enhancements
  • Bug fixes
  • Table updates
  • Occasional production support


Additional Requirements:

  • Must be comfortable working in SAP ECC for 12–18+ months without immediate S/4HANA exposure
  • Adaptable, autonomous, and able to “wear multiple hats” in a lean team environment

title: Automation Specialist - Especialista Senior
description:
Breve Descrição:

Responsável pela identificação conjunta de oportunidades relacionadas a automação e IA de atividades e processos operacionais do atendimento digital, por realizar a governança e curadoria das automações implementadas, bem como a responsabilidade de contribuir com o desenvolvimento de novas soluções de automação/IA personalizadas e/ou prontas para uso alinhadas à evolução do negócio junto ao time de infraestrutura de TI.


Principais atividades:

  • Elaborar o roadmap evolutivo do atendimento digital, considerando a estratégia de negócio e o contexto tecnológico, incluindo a evolução de soluções digitais e iniciativas com agentes de IA.;

  • Manter a visão de futuro do atendimento digital, identificando e avaliando gaps da arquitetura atual e propondo melhorias.
  • Buscar e propor oportunidades de evolução do atendimento digital ou adoção de novas práticas tecnológicas, por meio de estudos e prospecção de mercado em Telecom e Digital.
  • Coordenar ou executar a evolução da arquitetura existente utilizando melhores práticas, ferramentas emergentes e alinhamento às diretrizes corporativas.
  • Prospectar e avaliar evoluções aplicacionais em trabalho conjunto com grupos multidisciplinares.
  • Relacionar-se com diferentes áreas e níveis hierárquicos, garantindo alinhamento técnico entre arquitetura, digital e negócio.
  • Participar de PoCs para validar implementações, incluindo componentes aplicacionais e funcionalidades emergentes relacionadas à automação e IA no atendimento digital.


Experiência, conhecimentos e formação:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável pós-graduação ou especialização em Arquitetura de Software, Engenharia de Dados, Inteligência Artificial ou Transformação Digital.
  • Experiência sólida na elaboração e manutenção de arquiteturas de referência corporativas, com foco aplicacional e funcional.
  • Vivência em definição de padrões arquiteturais, governança técnica e alinhamento entre áreas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Experiência em apoiar múltiplas equipes na definição de soluções, avaliando requisitos, gaps e riscos tecnológicos.
  • Histórico na evolução de arquiteturas corporativas, propondo melhorias com base em práticas de mercado e tendências tecnológicas.
  • Atuação colaborativa com times multidisciplinares, contribuindo para decisões técnicas estratégicas.
  • Participação em PoCs e validação de soluções em cenários complexos.
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos de grande porte, preferencialmente com exposição a iniciativas digitais e aplicações de média/alta complexidade

description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We’re looking for a Data Scientist who has excellent hands on Python skills and Machine Learning experience — someone who lives and breathes code, optimizes for performance, and has proven mastery on competitive programming or data challenge platforms like LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle . In this role you will be working with Turing team members and AI researchers at Frontier Labs to devise techniques and build data sets to improve performance of models.

  • Build, test, and optimize high-performance Python systems used in large-scale AI and data pipelines.
  • Design and maintain modular, clean, and production-ready Python codebases.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (data, infra, and research engineers) to deliver reliable backend components.

  • Stay current with modern Python tools, frameworks, ML advancements and best practices.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience writing Python in production environments.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and core libraries (Pandas, NumPy, AsyncIO, Pytorch, Transformers, or similar).

Bonus:

  • Recognized performance in Kaggle , Codeforces , or ICPC/TopCoder contests.

Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work fully remotely, from anywhere.
  • Collaborate with world-class AI labs and frontier research companies .
  • Tackle real engineering challenges with high autonomy and ownership.

Evaluation Process:

We’re actively hiring for this role. If you know exceptional talent, please refer them at turing.com/referrals and earn money for successful referrals.

title: Sr. Full Stack Engineer
description:
Who We Are:

PureSpectrum is a rapidly growing market research and insights platform that simplifies technology, allowing researchers to gather and activate consumer data without disruption. As the go-to solution for high-quality multi-sourcing and fully automated research, PureSpectrum is helping to shape the future of insights.


Our Marketplace facilitates over 65 million online interviews annually, and our proprietary respondent-level scoring system, PureScore, continues to set the industry standard for data quality and reliability.


Recognized globally for both innovation and culture, PureSpectrum has been named one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces (2023–2025), included in Inc.’s Best Workplaces ), certified as a Great Place to Work (2022–2025), and featured on Built In’s Best Places to Work list (2023–2025). PS is rapidly becoming the leading solution for quality multi-sourcing and end-to-end automated research solution.


The Opportunity:

PureSpectrum is seeking a highly skilled Sr. Engineer to join our high-impact Product & Engineering team. This is a full-stack role with a primary emphasis on backend engineering. You will be responsible for architecting, developing, and maintaining the core services, scalable RESTful APIs, and cloud infrastructure that power our mobile application. In addition to infrastructure and API design, you will optimize database interactions to ensure high performance. This is a fast-paced role within our global organization, reporting directly to the Engineering Manager.


Location: Brazil (Remote)


Your Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop scalable, robust RESTful API endpoints using .NET Core to support high-volume data consumption.
  • Design and optimize database structures using MySQL and write optimized queries for better performance and data integrity.
  • Implement and maintain server-side logic, integrating with third-party services using C# and object-oriented design principles.
  • Deploy and maintain scalable cloud solutions on AWS, specifically utilizing EC2/Beanstalk, RDS, SQS, SES, SNS, S3, and Lambda.
  • Test drive development and write comprehensive Unit/Integration tests to ensure code quality and stability.
  • Follow best practices in version control (Git), CI/CD, and cloud deployments to ensure efficient release cycles.
  • Implement new features in our mobile app using Flutter.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a similar discipline from any recognized University.
  • 3-5 years of hands-on experience building back-end applications using .NET Core and ORMs like Entity Framework.
  • Strong proficiency in C# and deep understanding of MVC design patterns.
  • AWS Cloud Expertise: Proven experience designing, deploying, and maintaining scalable and reliable cloud solutions leveraging core AWS services, including EC2/Beanstalk, RDS, SQS, SES, SNS, S3, and Lambda.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases with a preference for MySQL, including schema design and query optimization.
  • Knowledge of JSON, HTML, YAML, REST standards, and Git version control.
  • Knowledge of build pipelines (e.g., AWS CodePipeline, Bitbucket, GitLab).
  • Knowledge of Linux and command line interface operations.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Basic knowledge of Flutter and/or native mobile development (iOS/Android), including the MVVM design pattern


Nice to Have

  • Experience with mobile development technologies, specifically Flutter/Dart.
  • Experience with Firebase.
  • Knowledge of Shell script, JavaScript, and Native mobile development for Android/iOS.
  • Experience in Agile/Scrum teams.
  • Comfort with fast-moving teams and working across time zones with distributed teams.


PureSpectrum Perks:

Join PureSpectrum and become part of our innovative culture (PSX), where we prioritize your professional growth and foster a strong sense of team connection. You'll be part of a rewarding, high-standard environment where team members genuinely enjoy regular celebrations and events—a truly exceptional experience at every level.





PureSpectrum is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited under the law.

title: React Developer
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a React Developer to join our Reinforcement Learning (RL) Gym project. You will be responsible for building and maintaining intuitive, high-performance web interfaces that enable researchers and engineers to visualize, interact with, and manage reinforcement learning workflows. This role requires strong React expertise and the ability to collaborate closely with backend and ML teams to deliver seamless user experiences.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain responsive web applications using React.
  • Build reusable UI components and libraries to support experimentation workflows.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate APIs and ensure smooth data flow.
  • Work with engineers and researchers to create visualizations for training, evaluation, and benchmarking results.
  • Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Ensure high code quality with testing, reviews, and adherence to best practices.
  • Troubleshoot issues, debug code, and contribute to continuous improvements in the frontend stack.


Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional experience in frontend development, with a strong focus on React.
  • Solid understanding of JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Experience with state management libraries
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs and integration with backend services.
  • Knowledge of frontend testing frameworks
  • Understanding of build tools and CI/CD workflows
  • Strong problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.
  • Good to have: Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Chart.js, Recharts) or exposure to ML/AI project interfaces.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.


Important Notes for Submission

  • Kindly prioritize candidates with immediate availability and confirm their commitment to 8 - 4 hrs/day with PST overlap.


Offer Details

  • Commitments Required: Full-time (8 hours/day). At least 4 hours per day and minimum 20 hours per week with an overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of Contract: 3 months (adjustable based on engagement)
  • Location: India, Pakistan, Nigeria, Kenya, Egypt, Ghana, Bangladesh, Turkey, Brazil, Mexico.


Evaluation Process

  • Candidates complete Interest Check Form (ICF)
  • Shortlisted candidates only will be invited for MTI

title: Data Architect (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Minimum 6 years of experience as a Data Engineer
  • Strong experience in Data Architecture
  • Hands-on experience with Cloud platforms: Azure, AWS, and/or GCP
  • Experience with Big Data tools and technologies, including Databricks
  • Solid experience with ETL processes and data integration via APIs
  • Experience across the full lifecycle: implementation, development, and maintenance
  • English level B2 or higher
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;

title: Content Specialist
description:
Our purpose


ecoPortal health and safety engagement software helps organisations amplify workplace safety. We give leaders the data they need to create awe-inspiring safety cultures that ignite their team’s potential.


Engaged teams are the beating heart of industry-leading, odds-defying workplaces, and we’re committed to helping clients achieve that.

Through our years, we’re anchored by our commitment to championing people. That commitment begins from the ground up... with our own team.


Our team culture is an organic creation built by our people, for our people. Differences are celebrated here, and we firmly believe that our diverse lived experiences work together to make us stronger as a whole.



The Opportunity


The Content Specialist is an exciting role in ecoPortal’s marketing team, directly contributing to our content strategy. You’ll be part of a team with big aspirations, changing perceptions of health and safety worldwide.



Ideal for someone who has:


  • A Bachelors (or higher) Degree in marketing/ journalism/ communications or similar major.
  • Exceptional written and verbal English fluency.
  • A strong understanding of SEO and CRO copywriting.
  • A flair for story-telling, with the ability to demonstrate technical writing.
  • A passion for writing with an excellent eye for detail, grammar, brand tone and style.
  • Experience in marketing in a tech and/or SaaS company is an advantage.
  • An understanding of the buyer journey and how best to capture people's interest at each stage.
  • Experience in managing Podcasts, Webinars and live content events.
  • The ability to meet deadlines, be a self-starter and have a can-do attitude.
  • Great communication skills, with the ability to liaise with both internal and external stakeholders regularly.


Key Responsibilities


  • Execution of the company’s content strategy, with the aim of educating, engaging, entertaining and empowering people across the company’s full customer lifecycle.
  • Be a driving force behind the execution of a broad range of top-notch content including ad campaigns, web copy, email marketing, blogs, case studies, webinars, event collateral, videos and more.
  • Planning webinar and podcast series and managing all production aspects, from prospecting and inviting potential speakers to writing briefings and scripts and supporting the recording or live delivery.
  • Creation of compelling monthly and quarterly newsletters, with ongoing performance tracking and a focus on finding new ways to improve engagement.
  • Keep your finger on the pulse of what’s front of mind for professionals in the world of health and safety and use that to input on content and campaign idea generation.
  • Support the Sales and Success teams by creating targeted collateral, emails, social posts and case studies to drive conversions and upsell opportunities;
  • Support the company’s SEO initiatives, scope and create content that helps the company get found via organic traffic;
  • Contribute to ecoPortal’s content strategy and execution.
  • Take a campaign approach to content development. Implement SEO best practices, test, and iterate your content and creative processes with the aim of increasing ecoPortal’s reach, generating demand, and converting prospects to customers.
  • Support other team-wide initiatives with targeted collateral (i.e. web, email) that leverages strong storytelling to get key ecoPortal messages across in inspiring and unique ways;
  • Keep your work in Trello and the content calendar up-to-date and set up other administrative processes as required;
  • Closely monitor new content trends, and proactively seek creative opportunities where these can be best utilised at the company.

  • Collaborate with other Creative Team members, including Graphic Designers, Video Specialists, as well as members of the Digital Marketing Team.

Perks & Benefits:


We hope that you're excited by the possibilities that come with working at ecoPortal! In addition to our welcoming and diverse culture, we also offer these fun perks and benefits.


37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team.


⛺️ Generous Annual Leave


Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with ecoPortal.


End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at ecoPortal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you’ve been with eP, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you’re here. ✈️ ️


Professional Development: ecoPortal offer financial assistance for Business English Language Courses, apps, or training.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager – NAMER
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager to lead and scale recruitment operations for NAMER (North America) clients within an AI/R company structure. This role is responsible for building high-performing talent acquisition strategies to support growth in cutting-edge areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and advanced software engineering.

You will act as a strategic partner to clients and internal leadership, ensuring hiring excellence, speed, quality, and alignment with business goals in a highly competitive and innovation-driven market.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end talent acquisition strategies for NAMER clients, managing full-cycle recruitment across technical roles within AI/R and technology environments;
  • Partner closely with clients, hiring managers, and executives to understand workforce planning, role requirements, and hiring priorities;
  • Build, manage, and develop high-performing recruiting teams, ensuring delivery excellence, hiring quality, and adherence to SLAs;
  • Design and optimize recruiting processes tailored to the NAMER market, including sourcing strategies, interview frameworks, and candidate experience;
  • Drive hiring initiatives for highly specialized roles, including AI Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Data Scientists, Cloud Engineers, and Product roles;
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing market insights, talent trends and compensation benchmarks;
  • Ensure compliance with NAMER labor regulations, diversity hiring practices, and internal recruitment standards;
  • Manage recruiting metrics and KPIs;
  • Support employer branding initiatives and represent the company in talent and industry events when applicable;
  • Collaborate with HR, People Operations, and leadership teams to align talent acquisition with broader organizational strategy.


Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Talent Acquisition Manager or Senior Talent Acquisition Partner in technology-driven environments;
  • Strong experience recruiting for the NAMER market, with a primary focus on US hiring practices;
  • Demonstrated success hiring for AI, Machine Learning, Data, Cloud, and software engineering roles;
  • Experience managing recruiting teams and working with multiple stakeholders and clients simultaneously;
  • Deep knowledge of full-cycle recruitment, sourcing strategies, and talent market dynamics in NAMER;
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills;
  • Experience working in fast-paced, scaling, or consulting environments.
  • Advanced English
  • Strong data-driven mindset

description:
Job Title: Azure/Windows Architect

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Key responsibilities:

  • Lead Azure migrations: Conduct on‑prem/public cloud infra assessments using Azure Migrate and drive solutioning for large, complex Azure migrations.

  • Stakeholder collaboration: Work with internal/customer stakeholders and PMs across banking, healthcare, and insurance domains; ensure risks are mitigated and lessons captured post‑project.


Must have skills:

  • Experience: 13+ years in IT; 5+ years in Azure Infra, Azure Migrate, Azure Networking (IaaS/PaaS), DC/Cloud/Security/SIAM/Data/Storage.
  • Azure services: Azure Key Vault, Azure IAM, Landing Zone design, BoM/pricing/licensing, TCO/ROI.
  • Windows administration: File/Print, DNS, WINS, DHCP, clustering, DFS; server consolidation, upgrades, backup/restore.
  • Migration & troubleshooting: On‑prem to Azure via Azure Migrate; deep troubleshooting in Azure & Windows environments.
  • Leadership & support: Team governance (5+), stakeholder management, 24×7 support readiness, shift flexibility.


Good to have:

  • Certifications: AZ‑305 (Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions), AZ‑104 (Microsoft Azure Administrator).
  • Design exposure: DR/business continuity, identity/governance/monitoring solutions; solution presentations and customer communication.

title: Senior Revenue Operations Associate
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
  • SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report ).


About The Role:

Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 5+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?

We are seeking a Sr. Revenue Operations Associate to play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, SpendHound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.


We expect East work hours.


As our Senior Revenue Operations Associate, you will partner with our Sales and Marketing teams to:

  • Be an operations subject matter expert for the Sales function, working closely with RevOps and Spendhound leadership to support Sales and execute on key initiatives
  • Implement processes and solutions that can streamline revenue acquisition and eliminate inefficiencies
  • Maintain and measure various components of the Sales process, such as
  • Target/Territory Management
  • Lead Generation and Outbound Cadence Operations.
  • Ensure that the Sales teams are operating seamlessly through data evaluation and by improving workflows


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Operations professional with 5+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team.
  • You demonstrate a high aptitude for organization, process development, project and change management, and analytics
  • You have advanced Excel skills
  • Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
  • You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
  • You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
  • You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around you


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

  • Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.g., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience.

  • Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes.
  • Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance.

  • Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions.
  • Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load.
  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.g., Python, SQL).
  • User Experience (UX) and Data Design
  • Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio.

  • Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly.


Requirements:

  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience working with Shiny for Python or similar interactive visualization frameworks such as Plotly, Dash, or Shiny for R , including building interactive dashboards and understanding core concepts like reactivity and UI/server architecture.
  • Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources.

  • Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.g., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny.

A Lynx Financial Crime Tech S.A, é uma empresa de software baseado em IA, especializada em detectar e prever padrões de comportamento. Liderados por uma equipe experiente do setor financeiro e acadêmico, desenvolvemos e implementamos tecnologias de IA de ponta e autoaprendizado. Nossa plataforma se destaca em tecnologias de processamento de transações de baixa latência e está disponível tanto on-premise quanto em nuvem.

Priorizamos VISÃO, AGILIDADE e VELOCIDADE para oferecer experiências excepcionais aos clientes e construímos relacionamentos duradouros e de confiança com algumas das principais instituições financeiras, fintechs e empresas comerciais em todo o mundo.

Adotamos uma forte cultura de risco e esperamos que toda a nossa equipe, independentemente do cargo que ocupem, tenha uma atitude proativa e responsável em relação à gestão de riscos. A Lynx se orgulha de ser uma organização com igualdade de oportunidades, independentemente de identidade de gênero, cultura ou deficiência. Nossa missão é contribuir para que mais pessoas e empresas prosperem.


O que você vai fazer

Como Professional Services Technician, seu objetivo será garantir um serviço excelente para nossos clientes sediados no Brasil (e em outras regiões da América Latina), participando ativamente das diferentes etapas do ciclo de vida: onboarding, implantação, acompanhamento e novas necessidades.

Precisamos de alguém como você para nos ajudar em diferentes frentes:

· Liderar e gerir projetos de implementação das nossas soluções.

· Gerenciar o relacionamento com os clientes: identificar novas necessidades, resolver dúvidas e oferecer orientação sobre o uso correto das nossas soluções.

· Fornecer consultoria especializada e executar os serviços profissionais das nossas soluções de Detecção e Prevenção de Crime Financeiro e Lavagem de Dinheiro.

· Dar suporte técnico aos nossos times internos de Vendas nas fases iniciais de contato com clientes: demos, reuniões técnicas etc.

· Atuar como elo entre nossos clientes e as equipes de Desenvolvimento e Suporte.


✅ O que buscamos em você

Experiência em gestão de projetos de tecnologia;

Ensino superior completo;

Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras ou empresas relacionadas ao setor;

Experiência em departamentos de Serviços Profissionais em outras empresas do setor;

Idiomas: domínio avançado de inglês (mandatório).

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts .   • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Senior Cloud SRE
description:
Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer

As a Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer , you will join a specialized engineering task force dedicated to preventing and resolving the most critical and strategic customer issues encountered in the field.

Our global team of experienced engineers has a deep understanding of the lower layers of private cloud infrastructure. Together, we work on practical solutions, continuously learning and adapting. We collaborate closely, share knowledge, and tackle challenges head-on.

If you're an engineer eager to understand the core of cloud technologies and looking for a team that values hands-on expertise , you'll fit right in with us.


What you will learn and contribute to

  • Maintain and enhance Red Hat private cloud: You’ll work extensively with Nokia Container Services (NCS) and CloudBand Infrastructure Software (CBIS) , private cloud solutions based on Kubernetes and OpenStack .
  • Deep Dive Troubleshooting: Starting from high-level Kubernetes error messages, you’ll navigate through multiple layers until pinpointing issues—even down to kernel-level bugs.
  • Automate and Develop: Spend 30–50% of your time developing automation to prevent recurring issues. Solve it once, automate for the future. Use your Python skills to create health checks and improve reliability.
  • Continuous Learning: In our rapidly evolving tech landscape, ongoing learning is a cornerstone.
  • Collaborate with Developers and Engineers: Work closely with developers and product engineers to bridge infrastructure and software, ensuring seamless product delivery.
  • Mode of Operation: This role requires participation in a follow-the-sun scheme with 12-hour shifts (within regulatory limits) or participation in on-call rotations to ensure business continuity during emergencies.


Your skills and experience

  • Linux Expertise: Strong familiarity with Linux distributions; we primarily use Red Hat and CentOS .
  • Networking Foundations: Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (VLANs, IP routing). Experience with Calico , Multus , and Open vSwitch is a plus.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Excellent troubleshooting skills and analytical thinking to address complex challenges.
  • Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in Bash and Python , or willingness to learn, plus familiarity with Ansible .
  • Containerization & Virtualization: Knowledge of Podman , Kubernetes , Helm , and/or OpenStack ; experience with KVM/QEMU is advantageous.
  • Storage Systems: Experience with Ceph and Rook is highly valued.
  • Database Expertise: Understanding of relational databases (MySQL , MariaDB ) and experience with etcd .
  • Monitoring and Logging: Familiarity with tools like ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) , Prometheus , and Grafana .
  • Advanced written and spoken English.


It would be nice if you also had

  • Proactive thinking and ownership mindset.
  • Strong focus on quality and reliability.
  • Passion for delivering training or knowledge-sharing sessions to operations teams.



Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

description:

title: \"Analista DevOps SR#984930\"
description:
A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós:

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


Nosso Cliente:

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente do ramo do varejo.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência em práticas DevSecOps e metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência em construção de pipelines (Azure DevOps);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração CI/CD (Azure DevOps);
  • Experiência com sistemas operacionais Linux e Windows;
  • Experiência com sistemas containers;
  • Experiência em ferramentas e boas-práticas de infraestrutura como código (Terraform e Helm);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento de código (Github, Gitlab, entre outras);
  • Experiência com administração e provisionamento de recursos em nuvem pública (AWS, GCP ou Azure);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Code Quality/Quality Gate como SonarCloud, Snyk, Gitleaks ou similares;
  • Conhecimento de integrações via API;
  • Conhecimento da ferramenta Backstage;
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação ou ferramentas de automação;
  • Conhecimento em processo de automação de testes;


Atuação 100% remoto - Brasil

Contratação CLT

title: Consultor(a) de Comunicação Interna (Eventos e Comunidade)
description:
A Screencorp é especialista em soluções de Comunicação Interna para aproximar empresas e colaboradores.


Nossa missão é ajudar empresas a se comunicarem melhor com seus colaboradores, fornecendo tecnologia relevante e contextualizada com o objetivo de aumentar engajamento e estabelecer um propósito compartilhado de trabalho.

O Desafio

Você será a \"cara\" da Screencorp para o mercado e para nossa base de clientes.

Seu papel é híbrido: você atuará na educação do mercado através de eventos, no fortalecimento da nossa rede de contatos em RH e na identificação de oportunidades estratégicas dentro dos clientes que já confiam na nossa marca.


Suas Principais Missões:
  • Gestão de Experiências: Planejar e executar o calendário de eventos (webinars, meetups remotos e eventos presenciais de networking) focados em tendências de CI e RH.
  • Fortalecimento de Comunidade: Atuar ativamente em grupos, associações e comunidades de RH/Comunicação para posicionar a Screencorp como autoridade no setor.
  • Faro de Negócios (Growth na Base): Atuar consultivamente com nossos clientes atuais para entender suas dores e identificar momentos ideais para ofertas de upsell (upgrade de plano) ou cross-sell (adoção de novos produtos do ecossistema Screencorp).
  • Embaixador(a) da Marca: Representar a empresa em feiras, congressos e entrevistas para a mídia, disseminando nossa cultura e visão sobre o futuro do trabalho.
  • Produção de Conteúdo Estratégico: Apoiar o time de marketing com insights vindos diretamente da comunidade para a criação de materiais que ajudem na conversão.

    • O que buscamos:
    • Formação em Comunicação Social, Relações Públicas, Jornalismo ou Marketing.
    • Experiência prévia com Organização de Eventos (do planejamento à execução).
    • Perfil \"Hunter\" de Relacionamento: alguém que sinta facilidade em abordar pessoas e construir pontes (Networking).
    • Visão de Negócios: entender que a comunicação deve estar alinhada aos KPIs de vendas e retenção.
    • Excelente oratória e desenvoltura para falar em público e em vídeos.
    • Desejável: Conhecimento prévio do mercado de SaaS ou vivência em RH/Endomarketing.


    Soft Skills que valorizamos:
    • Atitude de Dono: você encara cada evento como um projeto pessoal, agindo com autonomia e proatividade para superar as expectativas.
    • Escuta Ativa: essencial para identificar oportunidades de vendas de forma consultiva e natural.
    • Resiliência: para lidar com a dinâmica de eventos e negociações.
    O que oferecemos:
    • 100% Home Office (não iremos voltar ao presencial)
    • Ambiente respeitoso, informal e pragmático
    • Auxílio Home office
    • Flash Benefícios
    • Plano de saúde Sulamérica
    • Folga no aniversário
    • Enviamos os equipamentos eletrônicos necessários para seu trabalho
    • Contratação CLT

title: Sr. Full Stack Engineer
description:
Who We Are:

PureSpectrum is a rapidly growing market research and insights platform that simplifies technology, allowing researchers to gather and activate consumer data without disruption. As the go-to solution for high-quality multi-sourcing and fully automated research, PureSpectrum is helping to shape the future of insights.


Our Marketplace facilitates over 65 million online interviews annually, and our proprietary respondent-level scoring system, PureScore, continues to set the industry standard for data quality and reliability.


Recognized globally for both innovation and culture, PureSpectrum has been named one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces (2023–2025), included in Inc.’s Best Workplaces ), certified as a Great Place to Work (2022–2025), and featured on Built In’s Best Places to Work list (2023–2025). PS is rapidly becoming the leading solution for quality multi-sourcing and end-to-end automated research solution.


The Opportunity:

PureSpectrum is seeking a highly skilled Sr. Engineer to join our high-impact Product & Engineering team. This is a full-stack role with a primary emphasis on backend engineering. You will be responsible for architecting, developing, and maintaining the core services, scalable RESTful APIs, and cloud infrastructure that power our mobile application. In addition to infrastructure and API design, you will optimize database interactions to ensure high performance. This is a fast-paced role within our global organization, reporting directly to the Engineering Manager.


Location: Brazil (Remote)


Your Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop scalable, robust RESTful API endpoints using .NET Core to support high-volume data consumption.
  • Design and optimize database structures using MySQL and write optimized queries for better performance and data integrity.
  • Implement and maintain server-side logic, integrating with third-party services using C# and object-oriented design principles.
  • Deploy and maintain scalable cloud solutions on AWS, specifically utilizing EC2/Beanstalk, RDS, SQS, SES, SNS, S3, and Lambda.
  • Test drive development and write comprehensive Unit/Integration tests to ensure code quality and stability.
  • Follow best practices in version control (Git), CI/CD, and cloud deployments to ensure efficient release cycles.
  • Implement new features in our mobile app using Flutter.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a similar discipline from any recognized University.
  • 3-5 years of hands-on experience building back-end applications using .NET Core and ORMs like Entity Framework.
  • Strong proficiency in C# and deep understanding of MVC design patterns.
  • AWS Cloud Expertise: Proven experience designing, deploying, and maintaining scalable and reliable cloud solutions leveraging core AWS services, including EC2/Beanstalk, RDS, SQS, SES, SNS, S3, and Lambda.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases with a preference for MySQL, including schema design and query optimization.
  • Knowledge of JSON, HTML, YAML, REST standards, and Git version control.
  • Knowledge of build pipelines (e.g., AWS CodePipeline, Bitbucket, GitLab).
  • Knowledge of Linux and command line interface operations.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Basic knowledge of Flutter and/or native mobile development (iOS/Android), including the MVVM design pattern


Nice to Have

  • Experience with mobile development technologies, specifically Flutter/Dart.
  • Experience with Firebase.
  • Knowledge of Shell script, JavaScript, and Native mobile development for Android/iOS.
  • Experience in Agile/Scrum teams.
  • Comfort with fast-moving teams and working across time zones with distributed teams.


PureSpectrum Perks:

Join PureSpectrum and become part of our innovative culture (PSX), where we prioritize your professional growth and foster a strong sense of team connection. You'll be part of a rewarding, high-standard environment where team members genuinely enjoy regular celebrations and events—a truly exceptional experience at every level.





PureSpectrum is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited under the law.

title: Talent Data Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Talent Data Analyst to join our Talent team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data from our Talent team, extract insights, and help solve problems.

- Understand the Talent funnel and architect a Data solution from scratch, including the definition of KPIs and metrics.

- Work with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, identifying and querying data sources to get the required data.

- Cleanse and massage data into the shape required, creating datasets, reports, and dashboards to meet requirements.

- Present and gather feedback from stakeholders.

- Deploy data, reports, and dashboards to Data Analysis tools, developing reports according to analyst-defined specifications.

- Maintain and document the operational environment.


Requirements:


- At least 3 years of experience developing Business Intelligence dashboards and reports, analyzing, and visualizing data.

- An understanding of top-of-the-line Data Analysis tools. Previous experience with administration, licensing, security, and deployment is a plus.

- A solid understanding of the concepts involved in modeling relational data.

- Strong analytic skills, with a hands-on approach with the ability to deliver commitments.

- Superior organizational skills, with a disciplined approach to implementation, support, and documentation.

- Experience with ETL of data from a variety of sources using SSIS, Python, or similar technologies (is a plus).

- Knowledge of SQL Server database architecture (components and processes of the database) and/or experience with creating tabular data models in SQL Server (is a plus).

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!
